text.tspan: 3. Users can view a personalized timeline of posts from followed users.
4. Timeline updates should reflect new posts from followed users.
5. Followers may receive notifications for new posts (configurable).
1. Low latency in timeline refresh and search.
2. High availability in posts CRUD and reply/comment.
4. System should scale to high fan-out users (e.g., celebrities).
5. System should tolerate partial failures without blocking writes.
Fanout on write if user is not popular/paid (blue tick)
